data.name: Fariha
data.gender_notes: Fariha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'firaha' which means 'joy' or 'happiness'. The name Fariha carries the meaning “Joyful, Happy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fariha usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, happy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The one who brings joy and happiness to everyone around her.
data.etymology: Fariha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, Happy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fariha total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fariha represents a sense of joy and happiness, a positive trait that is cherished and valued in many cultures. In the Islamic world, it is believed that giving a child a beautiful name sets them up for success and joy in life. This name conveys a sense of optimism and positivity that can inspire those who bear it to be joyful and spread happiness in their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Fariha holds significant importance in the Islamic tradition. It is said that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) pronounced blessings upon those who were known as "Ash-Shahid al-Fariha," or those who bear witness to Fariha, referring to the bliss and joy that comes with the faith and practicing good deeds. The name is a reminder of the joy that comes with being close to Allah, the ultimate source of happiness and contentment.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Fariha bint Abd al-Malik was the wife of Caliph Marwan II. The name Fariha carried significant weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Fariha remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
